articles.title: Sarkisian talks about Arch Manning's incredible transformation and puts pressure on him: “He'll have to step up”
articles.standfirst: Manning aims to improve his form in a bid to guide Texas to the College Football Playoffs
articles.summary: Manning aims to improve his form in a bid to guide Texas to the College Football Playoffs
articles.body:
Arch Manning is heading into the Texas Longhorns ’ showdown with the Ole Miss Rebels carrying a different mindset, with Steve Sarkisian describing his quarterback as “edgy” after weeks of scrutiny over his offensive struggles. The change comes with Texas ’ College Football Playoff hopes under pressure as the Longhorns have lost consecutive games to unranked opponents, including October 17’s 27-24 defeat to the Florida Gators.

Manning has struggled to deliver consistently and with the Rebels next on the schedule, Texas needs a response from its quarterback and an offense that has fallen short of expectations. And Sarkisian believes the growing criticism has helped create a more combative version of Manning as the coach acknowledged that the narrative surrounding the quarterback has been shaped by everyone involved, including the media. "I would use the word edgy, and I like it. He’s edgy right now," Sarkisian said. "And I think that somebody texted me today that we lost the ‘Aw Shucks’ kid and we created something else. I don’t know if we lost him. We created this. We did. All of us. “Y’all included. Me. The whole thing, right. Everybody on ESPN, we’ve created this. And so we’ll see what comes out of it but he’s edgy right now. And honestly, I appreciate that about him. At some point, he’s gotta fight back. “And the best way for him to fight back is going out and playing really good football with his teammates and enjoy playing football with his teammates. And so I’m looking forward to watching him compete Saturday night." The challenge for Manning is to turn that attitude into better performances. Texas has struggled to establish a consistent offensive rhythm, and the quarterback has looked hesitant in the pocket during much of the season. Sarkisian ’s play-calling has also come under scrutiny.

Florida defeat increases pressure on Texas

The Longhorns ’ latest setback exposed problems on both sides of the ball as Florida , whose defense ranked last in the Southeastern Conference , held Texas below 300 total yards, sacked Manning five times and forced a fumble on his final possession. The Gators recovered from a 17-3 deficit to claim a 27-24 victory, with quarterback Tramell Jones Jr. throwing two touchdown passes to Lacota Dippre and Jadan Baugh scoring the go-ahead touchdown in the fourth quarter. Texas briefly answered through Manning ’s nine-yard touchdown pass to Cam Coleman , but could not regain control whilst their defense also surrendered lengthy scoring drives in the second half, while star edge rusher Colin Simmons left with an apparent ankle injury. The defeat followed another loss to an unranked opponent, intensifying questions about whether the Longhorns can meet their postseason ambitions as Texas entered the season with expectations of competing for a national championship. Particularly after Sarkisian made clear that simply reaching the College Football Playoff semifinals was no longer sufficient for the program. Now, the Ole Miss matchup has become a crucial opportunity to steady the season. Manning has shown he can play with greater aggression, including during Texas ’ fourth-quarter comeback against the Ohio State Buckeyes . Now he must do it again – especially if he hopes to retain his value heading into the 2027 NFL Draft .

articles.title: Utah defensive player has been suspended indefinitely over allegations of rape and sodomy
articles.standfirst: Jamal Wallace denies the accusations
articles.summary: Jamal Wallace denies the accusations
articles.body:
The Utah Utes ' defensive tackle Jamal Wallace has been suspended indefinitely while facing an investigation into allegations of rape and forcible sodomy as the player was arrested earlier this month over an alleged incident involving the sharing of videos.

Although he has not been criminally charged with rape or sodomy, Wallace was arrested on October 11 and released on $5000 bail as police in Salt Lake City reportedly recovered footage they believe he recorded and sent to five people through Snapchat .

Wallace has denied the allegations and according to TMZ, the accusations stem from a woman's account that he forced her to perform oral sex after the pair discussed the status of their relationship.

Wallace allegedly grabbed the woman by the neck before forcing her to perform the sex act and recorded the encounter and police reportedly found videos connected to the alleged incident and believe he was responsible for recording them.

However, the investigation remains ongoing, Utah confirmed that Wallace had been removed from the program shortly after the university learned of the situation as the suspension took effect on October 11.

That was the same day as his reported arrest, and remains indefinite while the legal process develops.

“We were made aware of the situation with Jamal Wallace on Oct. 11,” the Utes said to TMZ. “And he was immediately placed on an indefinite suspension from the program. We take these matters seriously.

"As this is a pending legal matter we have no further comment at this time.”

Utah's unbeaten season overshadowed by allegations

Wallace transferred to Utah from Tennessee Volunteers ahead of the current season and he has appeared in 10 games since 2024 and recorded seven tackles, but his immediate future with the Utes is now uncertain as the investigation continues.

The case has emerged as Utah enjoys one of its strongest starts in recent years as the Utes improved to 6-0 overall and 3-0 in Big 12 play after surviving a dramatic 27-24 victory over the Colorado Buffaloes .

Extending their winning streak to 12 consecutive games dating back to last season, Utah entered the rivalry matchup as a 15-point favorite and led 13-0 at halftime as Devon Dampier threw three touchdown passes.

The Utes held off a late Colorado rally to preserve their unbeaten record after an illegal forward pass penalty erased a potentially significant gain during a late lateral play by Deion Sanders ' team. Utah then defended the Buffaloes ' final pass attempt to secure the victory.

The result marked Utah 's best start since 2015 and left the team with the longest active winning streak in the FBS . However, Wallace 's suspension has shifted attention away from on field towards an extremely serious investigation.

articles.title: Lane Kiffin’s daughter complicates things for her father, as everything points to a breakup with a LSU star
articles.standfirst: Breakup rumors surrounding Landry Kiffin and Whit Weeks are gaining traction online
articles.summary: Breakup rumors surrounding Landry Kiffin and Whit Weeks are gaining traction online
articles.body:
Landry Kiffin and LSU linebacker Whit Weeks are at the center of breakup speculation after a series of social-media clues caught fans’ attention.

Neither has confirmed a split, but Landry’s recent activity has raised questions about their relationship and the situation facing her father, LSU head coach Lane Kiffin.

The rumors gained momentum after Landry shared a TikTok video during a visit to Dallas for the Red River Rivalry. She lip-synced to Big Sean’s “Beware,” including lyrics about a woman with a broken heart.

The post quickly prompted followers to wonder whether it hinted at trouble in her relationship.

Her activity in the comments added to the speculation. Reports say Landry liked messages suggesting she was single and responded to a fan who joked about returning a Halloween costume inspired by the couple.

They’ve also reportedly removed some references to each other from their social-media accounts. However, they continue following one another, and neither has publicly addressed the rumours.

Landry was in Dallas while LSU suffered a 35-34 overtime defeat to Kentucky. She attended Oklahoma’s 27-24 victory over Texas at the Cotton Bowl, wearing Texas gear and joking that she was “scouting out the competition.”

A personal story meets LSU’s football problems

The speculation has attracted additional interest because Lane Kiffin and Weeks share a coach-player relationship. Kiffin took charge at LSU after coaching at Ole Miss, where Landry’s previous relationship with quarterback Walker Howard also drew attention.

Howard transferred from LSU to Ole Miss in 2023, later moved to Louisiana and returned in 2026.

Weeks previously addressed the unusual arrangement of playing for his girlfriend’s father, saying it hadn’t affected their relationship. He explained that football remained the priority at LSU’s facilities, while away from the team, Kiffin was simply his girlfriend’s father.

Meanwhile, LSU has pressing concerns beyond the rumors. articles.title: The gruesome photos of Deion Sanders’ amputated toes shock his children Shedeur, Shilo, and Shelomi: "You should have kept them in a jar"
articles.standfirst: Shedeur Sanders calls for a warning sign as Deion reveals disturbing amputation photos
articles.summary: Shedeur Sanders calls for a warning sign as Deion reveals disturbing amputation photos
articles.body:
Deion Sanders has given fans a disturbing glimpse into one of the darkest chapters of his life, sharing graphic photographs of his amputated toes to mark five years since the medical ordeal.

The Colorado football coach posted images of his left foot on Instagram, prompting strong reactions from his children, including son Shedeur Sanders .

The photographs show surgical stitches, darkened skin and a pin protruding from one of his toes. Shedeur responded bluntly in the comments, writing, “Need a warning sign.”

“You should of kept them in a jar,” wrote Shilo , while Shelomi added: “JUMP SCARE”. Despite the shocking nature of the photographs, Sanders explained that he wasn't looking for sympathy.

Instead, he wanted to share his experience as a testament to his faith, promising to reveal more pictures to demonstrate “how good God is.”

Deion Sanders’ terrifying health battle and remarkable recovery

Sanders ' medical crisis began in 2021 after he underwent a procedure for a dislocated toe and an inflamed nerve. Complications involving dangerous blood clots and impaired circulation left him fighting for his health.

He spent 23 days in hospital and underwent eight surgeries in three weeks, with doctors even discussing the possibility of amputating his leg below the knee.

Ultimately, surgeons removed his big toe and second toe on his left foot. Despite the ordeal, Sanders returned to the Jackson State sideline in November 2021 in a motorized wheelchair. His team secured a 21–17 victory, with Shedeur delivering the decisive touchdown and Shilo Sanders recording an interception.

Sanders later opened up about the frightening experience in his documentary series, “Coach Prime,” explaining how the medical team had shifted from discussing toe amputations to considering a more extensive procedure to save his life.

His health struggles didn't end there. In 2023, he underwent another procedure to remove blood clots from his right leg. Two years later, he revealed that doctors had discovered a high-grade cancerous bladder tumor. Sanders subsequently underwent bladder removal surgery and later announced that he was cancer-free.

His family has occasionally turned to humor to navigate these difficult experiences. Shedeur once told his father he was “ten toes down” for him, prompting Sanders to joke, “No, I’m eight.” Shilo has also admitted that he struggled to look directly at his father's injured foot.

More recently, Sanders received custom silicone prosthetic toes designed to improve balance, stability and walking comfort. He celebrated the development by declaring himself “ten toes down again.”

His partner, Karrueche Tran , has found humor in the situation, affectionately nicknaming his altered foot “Little Foot.” She has also praised his determination not to let his medical challenges dictate his life.

Although the photographs might unsettle viewers, Sanders sees them as proof of his survival.

articles.title: Arch Manning faces a career crossroads as 2027 NFL Draft outlook gets murkier
articles.standfirst: The quarterback entered the 2026 season with enormous expectations following a productive 2025 campaign
articles.summary: The quarterback entered the 2026 season with enormous expectations following a productive 2025 campaign
articles.body:
A rch Manning’s difficult season at Texas has sparked a new debate about his future: Rather than entering t he 2027 NFL Draft, should the highly touted quarterback leave the Longhorns and continue developing at another college program? E SPN analyst Dan Orlovsky believes that could be Manning’s best option.

Speaking Friday on First Take, Orlovsky argued that the quarterback needs a better environment to develop his skills, amid mounting criticism of his performances and questions about whether Texas could soon turn to backup KJ Lacey. “I do not believe Arch should go to the NFL,” Orlovsky said, according to Awful Announcing. “I believe Arch should leave Texas and go to a place that can adamantly develop him as a quarterback, that gives you the ability to play quarterback.”

Orlovsky also suggested Manning’s relationship with Texas could be nearing its breaking point, regardless of what happens in the Longhorns’ Saturday matchup against Ole Miss. “I think whatever happens this weekend, cool, I think this relationship is certainly done,” he said.

The comments add another layer to the uncertainty surrounding Manning. Once viewed as one of the leading quarterback prospects for the 2027 draft, the Texas signal-caller now faces questions about his performance, his place in the starting lineup and whether remaining in Austin is the best path toward an NFL career.

Texas tries to recover from consecutive losses

Manning entered the 2026 season with enormous expectations following a productive 2025 campaign. His performance this year, however, has fallen short of those standards. Entering the Ole Miss game, Manning had thrown for 1,295 yards, 11 touchdowns and five interceptions. In 2025, he finished with 3,163 passing yards, 26 touchdowns and seven interceptions.

The comparison has intensified scrutiny of both Manning and the Texas offense. Orlovsky has argued that the Longhorns’ system is limiting the quarterback’s ability to operate effectively and has contributed to what he sees as a regression.

That criticism comes as Texas tries to recover from consecutive losses to Oklahoma and Florida, each by a narrow margin. The Longhorns climbed to No. 1 in the AP Top 25 after defeating then-top-ranked Ohio State, but fell to No. 19 in the latest poll. The change in fortunes has increased the pressure on head coach Steve Sarkisian, whose handling of the quarterback position could become one of the defining storylines of the season.

Backup KJ Lacey adds to the uncertainty

Manning’s starting job has also come under scrutiny after ESPN reported that Lacey received additional first-team practice reps during the week. That development raised questions about whether Sarkisian might make a change if Manning struggles against Ole Miss. No confirmed decision to bench Manning was included in the available reporting, but the increased work for Lacey suggests the coaching staff is preparing for different possibilities.

A quarterback change would represent a dramatic turn for Manning, whose name and pedigree helped make him one of college football’s most closely watched players before the season began. It would not, however, automatically mean his time at Texas is over. Nor does Orlovsky’s recommendation establish that Manning intends to transfer.

Leaving the Longhorns remains a possibility raised by outside observers rather than a confirmed plan from the quarterback. Still, the combination of disappointing statistics, a potential competition for the starting job and questions about Texas’ offensive system has created a difficult situation for Manning to navigate.

articles.title: Matthew McConaughey explains what makes Arch Manning’s job way harder than his as Texas QB goes through growing pains
articles.standfirst: The Texas Longhorns superfan had a lot to say ahead of the team’s game against Ole Miss.
articles.summary: The Texas Longhorns superfan had a lot to say ahead of the team’s game against Ole Miss.
articles.body:
Coming into this weekend, the Texas Longhorns were on the brink of a full-on collapse. To straight losses to unranked opponents had the potential to snowball into a season-threatening stretch, with No. 7 Ole Miss , Mississippi State , No. 22 Missouri , and No. 18 LSU on the horizon. Making matters more critical were Arch Manning ’s struggles.

Knowing how important the Ole Miss game was for Texas and Manning, Longhorns superfan Matthew McConaughey took the opportunity to get the Longhorns faithful riled up with a full letter titled “ Dear UT ” for The Players’ Tribune .

Matthew McConaughey has turned into one of Texas Longhorns' most important fans

McConaughey pleaded Texas fans to get rowdy at the stadium for the game, and left everyone with a chilling quote: “ So here’s the question. Wanna play it safe? Tighten up? Maybe go into a prevent defense mindset? Get on our mental heels instead of our toes? Maybe just say the lines, connect the dots, play the part? Make sure not to offend anybody? Dare NOT to be great? That’s a good recipe for regret. F**k that. All gas no breaks, baby. Vince Young at the Rose Bowl. ”

In his letter, he also indirectly explained what makes his job, as a film actor, so much different than that of a football player like Manning. In McConaughey’s eyes, his job is easy. Playing sports is the hard job, because you only get one chance to get it right - even though he feels his best work came on the first take.

Truth is, you only get one take. A movie set is the only place on earth where they give you five takes to get it right. In sports, and in life, it’s one and done. So make it count. Speaking of multiple takes, fact is that my best work has always been the first one. ​ ​In Interstellar, when Coop is watching the video of his kids on the spaceship — FIRST TAKE. In Dazed and Confused, when Wooderson says, ‘Alright, alright, alright’ — FIRST TAKE. In A Time to Kill, when Jake Brigance gives the closing argument — FIRST TAKE. In Dallas Buyers Club, when Ron pulls over to the side of the road and realizes he’s going to die — FIRST TAKE. In Wolf of Wall Street, when Hanna is beating his chest with the ‘Hmm—Hmm—Hmm’ tune — FIRST TAKE. ​ ​Why? Because I convinced myself I only HAD one take, even though I had more if I wanted.

Thankfully for Manning, he has more than one play throughout a game to get things right. But just one play can be the difference between a win and a loss. Thankfully for Texas, Manning got the job done against Ole Miss. And McConaughey was surely smiling the whole night through.

articles.title: Pat McAfee says he’s “ruining the whole sport” by going shirtless then does it again right on cue
articles.standfirst: The host found himself at the center of another unexpected moment on College GameDay and took the reactions to his shirtless antics in stride.
articles.summary: The host found himself at the center of another unexpected moment on College GameDay and took the reactions to his shirtless antics in stride.
articles.body:
P at McAfee knows how to turn almost any moment into a spectacle. His larger-than-life personality often steals the spotlight, and during a new episode of College GameDay, he proved it once again with a scene that started with a refusal.

It all began as McAfee talked about the atmosphere surrounding college football and the fans who kept shouting at him to take his shirt off. At first, the host insisted he wasn't going to give in to the crowd's demands and said he would keep his shirt on .

But his resistance didn't last long. During the live broadcast of College GameDay, ESPN's show that follows the biggest matchups in college football, McAfee eventually took off his shirt as fans and cameras watched.

He even used the moment to joke about his physique, admitting that he hadn't even worked out that morning . What seemed like a firm refusal quickly turned into another one of those spontaneous moments that McAfee has a knack for making all about himself.

“I'm ruining the whole sport,” McAfee joked

For McAfee, part of the appeal lies in that very energy: the over-the-top enthusiasm, the chaos, and the passion that make every game a different experience.

From the NFL to one of ESPN's most recognizable faces

Long before becoming one of the most recognizable personalities in sports television, McAfee made a name for himself in the NFL as a punter for the Indianapolis Colts , where he played from 2009 to 2016. During that time, he earned two Pro Bowl selections and was named an All-Pro in 2014.

After retiring from professional football, he found a new way to stay connected to the sport. His media career continued to grow, eventually leading him to host The Pat McAfee Show and join College GameDay, two platforms where he combines analysis, interviews, and a personality that's hard to ignore.

He has also brought that same style to WWE, working as a commentator and appearing at special events . Between football and professional wrestling, McAfee has built a career in which entertainment is just as important as sports. And if his latest appearance made anything clear, it's that he doesn't need much to turn a broadcast into a moment everyone ends up talking about.
